issues.where: phd_progress_report.md, validation results: 'Zero false positives were recorded in this 16-megapixel search area (upper bound 0.23 false positives at 95% confidence).'
issues.problem: Zero false positives in one search area cannot give an upper bound of 0.23 expected false positives at 95% confidence: under a Poisson model the one-sided 95% upper bound for zero observed counts is about 3.0 expected false positives for that exposure (rule of three). The bound must match the stated exposure.
issues.fix: Either state the exposure that the bound refers to so that it is correct (e.g. 0 false positives over 13 equivalent search areas gives about 0.23 per area), or report zero false positives with the correct one-sided 95% upper bound of about 3.0 for the single area. Keep every other value and the intentional gaps unchanged; update the matching fact in the facts list.
